_comment: Model registry for serve/serve_model.sh and for every client script. One entry per model key. `port` is a property of the MODEL, not of the GPU: a client always addresses a model at the same URL, so when the model is not currently served it gets connection-refused rather than a different model's answers. Clients must still assert GET /v1/models returns the expected key before generating. Prefill/chat-template fields are added by the prep step (01_prefill_probe.py) once the exact strings are frozen in doc/setup.md.

roles._note: Role names used throughout the code. B_near is the reader from the same model family as the writer (Qwen), B_far the reader from a different family (gpt-oss); the writer itself is A. The two were picked by the saturation screen, not in advance - the notes below record which candidates were tried and why the survivors won.
roles._comment: Filled/confirmed during prep. the different-family reader is chosen in the pre-registered design from the two candidates.
roles._B_far_note: decided 2026-09-08 after the n=32 probe grid (Probe 5): both candidates continue A's block and sit ~0.2 below A on problem_330 (gpt-oss 0.38-0.50, Olmo 0.45-0.54 answered-only, within each other's Wilson intervals); gpt-oss is 3-5x cheaper per rollout; it is the only model that ever leaves A's block (14/1024 re-opens into harmony's commentary channel, all in this model), which the probe's detector now catches. Olmo remains the fallback. the same-family reader is decided by the reader screen saturation screen per the pre-registered design (default qwen3.5-9b).
roles._B_near_extra_note: 2026-09-09: the reader screen found Qwen3.5-9B and 4B saturating high (1/20 in band each). Added two weaker/different near candidates to probe (prefilled CoT, 32k) and screen. Decision on the same-family reader pending the author.
roles._B_near_note: decided 2026-09-09 13:55 UTC after the reader screens: Qwen3-1.7B is the only near candidate clearing the >= 10-in-band rule (11/20; floor on A's hard problems, ceiling on the easy ones, undecided on A's mid-range). Qwen3.5-9B/4B/2B/0.8B and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 saturate high (or loop). Trace sets are per reader (the pre-registered design changelog 2026-09-09): the 1.7B shares 5 in-band problems with gpt-oss. The earlier the pre-registered design rule (9B, fallback 4B) is superseded; no fallback remains.

r1-distill-14b.role: A (author; local runs only: the calibration run calibration, Phase 2 trace generation)

recommended_sampling._source: README:833 'Thinking mode for general tasks' (no generation_config.json in snapshot)

qwen3.5-9b._max_num_seqs_note: Hybrid Mamba model: vLLM 0.28 needs one Mamba cache block per decode sequence and refuses to start when its default max_num_seqs (1024) exceeds the blocks that fit - at --gpu-memory-utilization 0.45 on a 96 GB card only 677 fit ('max_num_seqs (1024) exceeds available Mamba cache blocks (677)', runs/serve/qwen3.5-9b.log 2026-09-09 00:17). 256 is above anything a script sends (the screen: 4 problems x 40 samples = 160). Batch-size limit only; does not change sampling. Added 2026-09-09 (the reader screen).

recommended_sampling._source: README:833 'Thinking mode for general tasks' (same card as 9B)

qwen3.5-4b._max_num_seqs_note: Hybrid Mamba model: vLLM 0.28 needs one Mamba cache block per decode sequence and refuses to start when its default max_num_seqs (1024) exceeds the blocks that fit - at --gpu-memory-utilization 0.45 on a 96 GB card only 677 fit ('max_num_seqs (1024) exceeds available Mamba cache blocks (677)', runs/serve/qwen3.5-9b.log 2026-09-09 00:17). 256 is above anything a script sends (the screen: 4 problems x 40 samples = 160). Batch-size limit only; does not change sampling. Added 2026-09-09 (the reader screen).

gpt-oss-20b._flags_note: TRITON_ATTN: vLLM's default FLASHINFER attention cannot JIT for sm120 with the system CUDA 12.8 (the project log 2026-09-08). Env var VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND is ignored in vLLM 0.28; only the CLI flag works. decided 2026-09-08.
gpt-oss-20b._reasoning_note: The harmony template stamps 'Reasoning: medium' and 'Current date: <today>' into the system message. decided 2026-09-08: keep the template's defaults (reasoning_effort medium, date as rendered); frozen prompt strings in doc/setup.md carry the probe day's date.

recommended_sampling._source: no published recommendation (model card, OpenAI cookbook, vLLM recipe checked 2026-09-08); generation_config.json is do_sample only = framework defaults; cookbook example uses temperature=1

qwen3-4b-thinking-2507.role: the same-family reader candidate (added 2026-09-09, human request after the reader screen)

recommended_sampling._source: README:208 'We suggest using Temperature=0.6, TopP=0.95, TopK=20, and MinP=0'; README:209 leaves presence_penalty optional (0-2) - not set

qwen3-4b-thinking-2507._note: Plain Qwen3 transformer (Qwen3ForCausalLM), thinking-only: the chat template ends '<think>\n' regardless of enable_thinking; no trim of the user content (INSTRUCTION's trailing space survives).

qwen3.5-2b.role: the same-family reader candidate (added 2026-09-09, human request after the reader screen)

recommended_sampling._source: README:707 'Thinking mode for text tasks: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5' (also :844-849 example with enable_thinking=True, :972-973); identical to the 9B/4B family settings. README:585: the 2B 'operates in non-thinking mode by default' - we force thinking via the template (enable_thinking=True -> '<think>\n'). README:893 warns the 2B 'is more prone to entering thinking loops' under these settings - expect cap hits.

qwen3.5-2b._note: Same family as qwen3.5-9b/4b (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, linear-attention hybrid, multimodal): same serving flags; template trims user content ('Solution:<|im_end|>') and ends '<think>\n'.

qwen3.5-0.8b.role: the same-family reader candidate, tier 2 (2026-09-09: run only if the 2B and the 4B-Thinking-2507 saturate)

recommended_sampling._source: README:707 'Thinking mode for text tasks: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5'; README:585: non-thinking by default, we pass enable_thinking=True (template ends '<think>\n').

qwen3.5-0.8b._note: Same family as the 2B (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, 24 layers, linear-attention hybrid, multimodal): same flags.

qwen3-1.7b.role: the same-family reader (chosen 2026-09-09 on the reader screen)

recommended_sampling._source: README:132/:275 'For thinking mode (enable_thinking=True), use Temperature=0.6, TopP=0.95, TopK=20, and MinP=0' (also generation_config.json)

qwen3-1.7b._note: Original Qwen3 hybrid-thinking model (Qwen3ForCausalLM, 28 layers). Its template with enable_thinking=True ends '<|im_start|>assistant\n' WITHOUT '<think>' - the model writes the opener itself - so _OPENER_AFTER_TEMPLATE appends '<think>\n' (as for A's raw prompt). User content not trimmed.

_sampling_note: recommended_sampling = each model's own shipped/recommended generation settings. Since the 2026-09-08 decision (the design changelog, configs/phase1.json reader_sampling.per_model) every script samples each reader with these, via src/common/sampling.reader_sampling; the cap comes from phase1.json. Keys beyond temperature/top_p must be vLLM sampling fields (sampling.EXTRA_KEYS).
